name: magictee_v3_4_H_orthogonal_reactive_cell
purpose: separate H spectral-slope, reactive, level, and phase controls before residual tuning

H_candidate.topology: mild reduced-width throat then localized symmetric reduced-height capacitive cell then terminal double ridge

acceptance.decision_metric: 4x4 complex-reflection Jacobian must be numerically full-rank before large optimization

notes: 20.4 mm throat width is a linearized seed from the measured v2 to v3.3 band-edge slope reversal.
Reduced-height cell is intentionally shallow and short to add a reactive degree of freedom without using a thin tuning screw.
No 30 kW qualification is implied until local field enhancement is extracted with rounded final geometry.
The committed v3.4 center solve improves H/even worst-band RL to 2.663 dB and |t_H|min to 0.677; the 8 perturbation solves are still required before claiming Jacobian rank.
The terminal-ridge-width central-difference half-step is reduced from 0.8 mm to 0.5 mm so both perturbation points stay inside the documented 4.0--6.5 mm range.
